response.what_it_is: Black standing cooker with three gas burners, one electric hotplate, and an oven
hidden_risks: Whether all gas burners and the electric hotplate ignite and heat properly
Functional condition of the oven and internal grill
Potential gas leaks or faulty electrical wiring
response.best_proof: A video or photo showing the burners and electric hotplate lit and working, as well as the inside of the oven.
response.failure_mode: AI might overlook that this is a hybrid cooker featuring an electric hotplate alongside gas burners, or mistake exterior cleanliness for internal perfection.
